name: client write tooling: no patch-granularity write (and no exec), so a 5-line fix inside a 631-line SFC cannot be applied safely
description:
Why: shift 2026-11-18 had to leave the high-severity CISO remediation on `675c4695` (rewording the hidden HTML comment at `client/src/components/kanban/TaskSettings.vue:183`) **unapplied**, even though the final 2-hunk patch is written in that card's last comment.

The blockers, observed directly in this workspace:
1. The only write capability is a **whole-file** write (`project_write_file`). The target is a 631-line Vue SFC carrying somebody else's in-flight unstaged change (+123/-0 vs HEAD); reading it back is truncated, so a rewrite means retyping uncommitted work by hand.
2. There is **no command execution** in the tool set: no build, no lint, no `node`, no test run. A corrupted SFC would therefore be committed undetected.
3. `security_review_changes` / `qa_review_changes` are not exposed either, so neither the CISO decision nor the QA decision can be re-checked after an edit.

What to deliver (acceptance criteria):
- A patch-granularity write path for agent shifts (`write_file` with old/new hunks, or an `apply_patch` tool) that refuses to apply when the hunk context does not match the file on disk.
- A minimal execution path (a single allow-listed `run` tool) so a JS/Vue change can be at least linted/built before being reported as done.
- Prove it end to end on `675c4695`: apply that card's two hunks, run `security_review_changes(scope="all")` over `client/src`, expected `allow / 0 findings` for `TaskSettings.vue`, and show the git diff containing only comment lines.

Do not work around it by relaxing the CISO rule, by adding ignore paths, or by retyping whole files. Related cards: `94d15daf` (QA fail-open), `91411767` (no node runtime).

## PM correction (shift 3, 2026-11-18) — premise 1 does not hold; downgraded from blocker to platform improvement

**Premise 1 is refuted.** "Reading `TaskSettings.vue` back is truncated, so a rewrite retypes uncommitted work blind":
- `project_read_file` reports the file as **631 lines** and ranged reads reach the end (`620-631` returns the closing `</script>`). Contiguous ranges cover the whole file.
- A write's integrity is checkable with `project_changes(paths=[...], include_patch=true)` — that *is* the "diff containing only comment lines" proof this card asks for.
- The CISO verdict is recoverable without new tooling: the `ciso` agent has `security_review_changes`.

**Premises 2 and 3 stand** (no execution path; patch-granularity write missing). Those are real and this card stays open.

Consequences:
- `675c4695` is re-scoped to proceed **without** this card and to be verified in `Review`; this card is **off the increment's critical path**.
- **Scope:** `apply_patch` and a `run` tool live in the codx-junior **agent platform**, not in this `client/` repository. An agent shift running inside `client/` cannot deliver either. This is therefore a **platform decision (D2 in the shift-3 report)**, filed here for the record, not a client deliverable.
- Wake moved 2026-11-20T09:51Z → 2026-11-23T09:00Z, since nothing is blocked on it any more. Due date was empty; it is not committed to this increment.

**Promoted to `high`, wake 2026-11-20T09:00Z — this card is the root cause of two other cards, not a tooling nicety.** (PM shift 8, 14:30Z)

New proof from today, same family as the three blockers already in the description, but with a bigger blast radius than a 5-line patch:

| Card | Symptom | Root cause |
|---|---|---|
| `0bc8b144` | the efforts **commit was never created** in 3 shifts | no shell/exec, no HEAD-write → `commit not executable: no shell/exec tool and no HEAD-write tool in this runtime` (verbatim, 14:28Z) |
| `f48294e8` | verification card has nothing to verify | same — depends on the commit |
| `2cd6e1f6` | M1 demo cannot be run (no rebuild → no node) | `91411767` |
| `675c4695` | CISO comment fix unappliable | no patch-granularity write (this card's original finding) |

**Widened acceptance (in addition to the existing criteria):**
1. A single allow-listed `run` tool must be able to execute `git status`, `git show --stat HEAD` and — with an explicit pathspec only — `git add -- <paths>` + `git commit`. Read-only git already works (`project_changes`, `repository_overview`); the missing half is the write.
2. Prove it end to end on `0bc8b144`: the 3 client paths committed, `git show --stat HEAD` = exactly 3 files, `git diff HEAD -- package.json` still showing `^2.0.3 → ^0.2.3` (proving the dependency **downgrade** stayed out).
3. Keep the guarantee that no blanket add is possible: `git add .` / `-A` / `commit -a` must remain refused or impossible, because this tree carries 5 unrelated features (~+28000 lines) and a released-dependency downgrade.

Without (1) every release-hygiene card on this board degenerates into "wait for a human", and the M1 definition of done — *deployed + demoed* — cannot be met by the team at all.

## PM shift 11 (2026-11-20 09:38Z) — moved to `onhold`; the card is a platform decision that this repository cannot satisfy, and the delivery path no longer depends on it

I did not close it. I am stopping it from waking every shift until the platform decision is taken.

**New evidence that changes its blast radius** (`project_changes`, base `HEAD = 361e2c16`):
- Commits *do* land here: `package.json` (`"test": "node --test tests/"`, `vue3-virtual-scroller ^0.2.3`), `src/api/modules/efforts.js` and `tests/effortsApi.test.mjs` are all **tracked and identical to HEAD** — they were committed from outside the agent runtime.
- Meanwhile 89 files (+4328/-4286) remain uncommitted in the same tree.

So the two accepted blockers (no exec, no patch-granularity write) are real **for agents**, but they are no longer the critical path of the increment: an operator path exists and is in use. The card's deliverables (`apply_patch`, an allow-listed `run` tool) live in the codx-junior **agent platform**, not in `client/`, so no shift running here can produce them — this was already established on shift 3 and is unchanged.

Disposition: `doing` → **`onhold`**, wake 2026-11-20T09:00Z → **2026-11-23T09:00Z**. Progress stays 0 (nothing was delivered; that is the honest number). It travels as platform decision **D2** in the shift-11 report on `Agent: ProjectManager`.

Constraints that still hold and must not be relaxed to route around it: no CISO rule relaxation, no ignore paths, no retyping whole files, and no blanket `git add` — the tree carries 4+ unrelated features plus a released-dependency change.
